description: This file provides security-related utility functions for authentication within a FastAPI application, including password hashing, JWT token creation and decoding, and specific JWT generation compatible with Supabase Realtime.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hash a password using passlib bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verify a plain password against a hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Create a signed JWT access token for API auth.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decode and validate an API JWT token.

methods.name: str create_supabase_realtime_jwt(subject: str, role: str = "authenticated", channels: Optional[list[str]] = None, expires_minutes: int = 60)
methods.description: Mint a Supabase Realtime-compatible JWT using Supabase JWT secret.
